blocks.question: 1. What Are Cookies?
blocks.answer: Cookies are small text files that websites may store on a visitor's device. They can help websites remember shopping baskets, maintain sessions and support other functionality.

blocks.text: These cookies may support:
Functional cookies may remember user preferences and website settings.
Where enabled, analytics cookies may help us understand website visits, page usage and technical performance.
Where enabled, advertising cookies may support campaign measurement and advertising personalisation.
First-party cookies are associated with the website you are visiting.
Third-party services may use cookies in connection with payments, analytics, advertising and other integrations.
Session cookies generally expire after the browsing session.
Persistent cookies may remain on your device for a defined period.
Where UK law requires consent for non-essential cookies or similar technologies, those technologies should only be activated after valid consent has been obtained.
Rejecting optional cookies should be as straightforward as accepting them.
You can manage cookies through your browser settings and any available website cookie preference controls.
Disabling essential cookies may affect website functionality.
The actual cookie names, providers, purposes and retention periods depend on the technologies installed on the live website.
A current cookie inventory should be made available through the website's cookie information or preference interface.
We may update this Cookie Policy when our website technologies or legal obligations change.

Email: info@jdhardware.shop
Telephone: 020 7606 3333
280A Norwood Road, Norwood, London SE27 9AJ, United Kingdom

blocks.text: JD Hardware aims to provide an online shopping experience that is accessible to customers with different abilities and needs.
We aim to make it easier for customers to:
We use the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA as a reference goal for accessibility improvements.
This statement does not claim that the website has been independently audited or certified as fully compliant.
We aim to support keyboard navigation across essential website functions.
We aim to improve compatibility with assistive technologies.
Our accessibility objectives include readable text, appropriate contrast, descriptive links and logical heading structures.
We aim to provide alternative text for informative images where appropriate.
We recognise the importance of clear form labels, understandable errors and accessible checkout controls.
We aim to provide usable layouts across common mobile and desktop devices.
Some third-party payment, chat or other integrations may have accessibility limitations.
If you experience difficulty accessing our website, please contact us.
Include the relevant page and a description of the problem.
Where an accessibility barrier prevents completion of an essential shopping task, our support team can review available assistance options.

blocks.text: JD Hardware recognises the importance of providing customers with information about their privacy rights.
This page explains the privacy choices that may be available under UK data protection law.
Subject to applicable law, you may have the right to:
You may request access to personal information held about you.
You may request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal information.
You may request deletion of personal information where applicable.
Certain information may need to be retained for legal, accounting, tax or other lawful purposes.
In certain circumstances, you may request that processing be restricted.
You may have the right to object to certain processing, including direct marketing.
Where applicable, you may request certain personal information in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format.
Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw that consent.
Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before consent was withdrawn.
You can unsubscribe from promotional emails using the unsubscribe option provided.
Where available, use our cookie preference controls to manage optional tracking technologies.
You may also manage cookies through your browser.
Email info@jdhardware.shop.
Use the subject line Privacy Rights Request.
Describe the request and provide enough information for us to identify the relevant records.
We may request reasonable identity verification.
We aim to respond to valid requests within the timeframes required by applicable data protection law, generally within one month, subject to permitted extensions.
If you have concerns about our handling of personal information, please contact us.
You may also complain to the Information Commissioner's Office.
ICO Website: https://ico.org.uk/
